Privacy.Heading: Privacy Policy
Privacy.ResponsibleText: The controller responsible for data processing on this website is Oliver Herlemann (contact details in the Legal Notice above).
Privacy.HostingText: This website is hosted by ALL-INKL.COM (Neue Mediengesellschaft Ulm mbH). When you visit this website, the hosting provider automatically processes technical data (e.g. IP address, date and time of access, page accessed, browser used) in the form of server log files. This processing is based on Art. 6 (1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in the secure and stable operation of the website).
Privacy.FontsText: This website uses Google Fonts. However, the font files are not loaded live from Google's servers on each page visit. Instead, they are embedded locally at build time and served from this website's own server. No connection to Google's servers is established and no data is transmitted to Google.
Privacy.ContactText: The contact button on this website simply opens the email program installed on your own device with a pre-filled recipient address (mailto link). No data is transmitted to me or to any server through this button; whether and what data you send me by email is entirely your own decision when composing and sending that email through your own email program.
Privacy.CookiesText: This website does not use cookies or any comparable tracking or analytics technologies.
Privacy.RightsText: You have the right at any time to request information about your stored personal data, its origin and recipients, and the purpose of its processing (Art. 15 GDPR), as well as, where applicable, a right to rectification (Art. 16 GDPR), erasure (Art. 17 GDPR), restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR), and data portability (Art. 20 GDPR).
Privacy.ComplaintText: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority regarding the processing of your personal data. The competent authority is the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information of Baden-Württemberg (Landesbeauftragter für den Datenschutz und die Informationsfreiheit Baden-Württemberg).
